name: audit-fixture-postinstall-sibling-husky
_comment: Phase 2 hoisted compat audit. Postinstall-sibling-mutation fixture. husky is the canonical example of a package whose postinstall writes OUTSIDE its own directory — specifically, it creates `.husky/` at the project root (a sibling of node_modules). lpm's lifecycle script sandbox has to allow this write OR the install can't complete. Same way under both linker modes if the sandbox config is correct.
